summary: Full e2e testing of FORGE app - backend APIs and frontend UI. Found and fixed critical MongoDB ObjectId serialization bug in POST /api/habits, POST /api/completions, and POST /api/ai/insight. All 18 backend tests pass after fix. Frontend loads correctly with all 5 pages working.

critical.issue: MongoDB ObjectId serialization error - insert_one() mutates the dict adding _id field, causing 500 response: ValueError: ['ObjectId' object is not iterable]
critical.status: FIXED - added habit.pop('_id', None), completion.pop('_id', None), doc.pop('_id', None) after each insert_one

ui_bugs.issue: AI insight text rendered with raw markdown (**bold**, **text**) instead of formatted HTML. The emergentintegrations LLM returns markdown but frontend renders it as plain text.

integration_issues.issue: Clicking 'FORGE' text on bottom nav didn't navigate to /achievements during playwright test - navigated to dashboard instead. Direct URL navigation to /achievements works correctly. May be a test-click positioning issue, not a real bug.

issues: TEST_Run habit shows 3 stars despite priority 2 - stars display may be incorrect (shows P3 stars for P2 habit)

action_items: DONE: Fixed MongoDB ObjectId serialization in POST /api/habits, POST /api/completions, POST /api/ai/insight
Consider rendering markdown in AI Coach insight display (parse ** to bold)
Verify star rating display for habits matches priority (P2=2 stars, P3=3 stars)
critical_code_review_comments: MongoDB _id ObjectId serialization bug - insert_one() mutates dict in-place adding _id. All 3 POST endpoints returning objects were affected. Fixed by calling .pop('_id', None) after insert_one.
AI insight content contains markdown formatting (**bold**) from LLM output but frontend renders as plain text - consider adding a markdown renderer like react-markdown
server.py is 719 lines - acceptable but borderline; consider splitting routes into separate files if more features are added

success_rate.frontend: 95% (all pages load, minor markdown rendering issue in AI Coach)

context_for_next_testing_agent: Test user: test-user-forge-001, session token: test_session_forge_001. Backend 100% passing. Fixed ObjectId bug in server.py. Frontend all 5 pages work. AI insights use template fallback (MOCKED) since no Azure key configured. Minor: AI insight text shows raw markdown formatting.
rca_of_issue: POST endpoints (habits, completions, ai/insight) were returning 500 because motor's insert_one() mutates the document dict by adding _id (ObjectId) in place. FastAPI's jsonable_encoder cannot serialize ObjectId objects. Fix: call dict.pop('_id', None) after each insert_one() call before returning the document.
